g.text: From security signals to a defensible change
AI can expand investigation and proposals. The harness preserves evidence and keeps consequential decisions explicit.
Scanners and enriched findings / asset inventory / source control and CI / ownership and change control
ONE PERSISTENT CASE / producer + subject + evidence + limitations + decisions + history
Expose uncertainty and the reason for each
A fix must address the issue and preserve the
PILOT MEASURES Investigation + review time / accepted correct fixes / regressions / cost per accepted outcome
Ask: where does evidence turn into repeated work or a stalled decision today?
Value is a pilot hypothesis. The local core does not run a model; native-host execution and optional Cursor are separate capabilities.
